_README: Who can sign in with Google, and what they get. EDIT THIS FILE, not Python.
Keys are the shared ufais.org officer mailboxes, which pass from one officer
to the next, so this list rarely changes between terms. Anyone not listed
here (or added under Settings -> Officer Access) is refused.
role      : vp, president, or admin (treasury@: same as the treasury password).
committee : the committee ID the person lands on (ais_fmd/config/categories.py).
Source: E-Board meeting notes and treasury@ mail, 2026-10-26. corporate@ is
the VP of Operations, whose committee replaced Corporate Relations (ID 6).
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored.
